## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated for the change (`pnpm test` passes)
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck` passes locally
- [ ] **Changeset added** (`pnpm changeset`) — required for any change to `@sunwjy/funnel-core` or `@sunwjy/funnel-client`; not needed for docs/CI/examples-only changes
- [ ] Examples updated if a public API changed (`examples/*` must keep passing CI)
- [ ] README updated if behavior or event mapping changed
